environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task definition mounts an EFS volume for the SQLite database. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL contains a single custom rule group (priority 0) with a RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string component. The RegexPatternSet includes patterns: `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|select\s+.*\s+from|insert\s+into|delete\s+from|drop\s+table|update\s+.*\s+set)`, `(?:['"]\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)`, and `(?:--|#|/\*)`. The rule action is Count. A second rule in the ACL references the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (priority 1) with SizeConstraint override on the `query_string` field set to 128 bytes with action Block. The custom rule group has a label `awswaf:managed:custom:sqli-detect` and a label-match rule (priority 2) that blocks requests matching that label. The Fargate task has a read-only root filesystem with the EFS mount at /data. Container runs as non-root UID 1000.
